description: Java class 'DataServices' providing various content data management services such as creating, updating, and rendering data resources, electronic texts, files, images, and binary files within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: DataServices
classes.description: Contains static methods for managing content data resources, electronic texts, files, images, and binary data within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: clearAssociatedRenderCache
methods.description: Clears the render cache associated with a specific data resource ID.

methods.name: createDataResourceAndText
methods.description: Creates a DataResource and optionally associated ElectronicText.

methods.name: createDataResource
methods.description: Wrapper for creating a DataResource with permission checks.

methods.name: createDataResourceMethod
methods.description: Creates a DataResource entity with provided context data.

methods.name: createElectronicText
methods.description: Wrapper for creating ElectronicText with permission checks.

methods.name: createElectronicTextMethod
methods.description: Creates ElectronicText linked to a DataResource.

methods.name: createFile
methods.description: Wrapper for creating a file with permission checks.

methods.name: createFileNoPerm
methods.description: Creates a file without permission checks, with validation for filename and content.

methods.name: createFileMethod
methods.description: Creates or writes to a file based on provided data and resource type.

methods.name: updateDataResourceAndText
methods.description: Updates DataResource and optionally ElectronicText.

methods.name: updateDataResource
methods.description: Wrapper for updating a DataResource with permission checks.

methods.name: updateDataResourceMethod
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing DataResource entity.

methods.name: updateElectronicText
methods.description: Wrapper for updating ElectronicText with permission checks.

methods.name: updateElectronicTextMethod
methods.description: Creates or updates ElectronicText linked to a DataResource.

methods.name: updateFile
methods.description: Wrapper for updating a file with permission checks.

methods.name: updateFileMethod
methods.description: Updates or writes content to a file based on context.

methods.name: updateImage
methods.description: Wrapper for updating image data.

methods.name: updateImageMethod
methods.description: Updates image data resource with new image bytes.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Wrapper for creating an image data resource.

methods.name: createImageMethod
methods.description: Creates an ImageDataResource with provided image bytes.

methods.name: createBinaryFile
methods.description: Wrapper for creating a binary file with permission checks.

methods.name: createBinaryFileMethod
methods.description: Creates a binary file from byte array data.

methods.name: updateBinaryFile
methods.description: Wrapper for updating a binary file with permission checks.

methods.name: updateBinaryFileMethod
methods.description: Updates binary file content from byte array data.

methods.name: renderDataResourceAsText
methods.description: Renders a DataResource as text and writes to provided writer.
